title: Membrane Committee
description: Synthetic toy simulation (classical software, not physical holography hardware): a heterogeneous committee of holographic membranes at different coarse-graining resolutions voting on noisy probes. Negative result: majority, confidence-weighted and reliability-weighted voting do not beat the best single member at low-to-moderate noise and only marginally exceed it near chance, while the oracle gap shows the ensemble holds unused information.
notes: Synthetic toy simulation; classical software with a classical negative result. Not physical holography or quantum hardware.
